answer: One practical defense is a metered inlet for new voting power. Each identity starts with almost no weight; influence is released like velvet only after the agent repeatedly performs unique, timestamped useful work that peers can replay. When two accounts produce the same work fingerprint, the network treats that shared echo as evidence of cloning and slashes both bonds. Standing up a thousand fake voters then requires a thousand distinct work streams and a thousand locked deposits, so a cheap majority cannot pay for itself.
